issue_request: FHIR-25056 was Published/Persuasive for R5 and requested adding RequestGroup as an output option for PlanDefinition/$apply because the operation listed only CarePlan.
initial_application: Commit 95d682222790d843e4f8232f990ef2827f436fa2 (J#25056) applied the issue by adding useCarePlan and changing the return from CarePlan to Resource documented as CarePlan or RequestGroup.
additional_context: FHIR-24619 renamed RequestGroup to RequestOrchestration. FHIR-33169, already represented on the combined branch, later removed useCarePlan and changed PlanDefinition/$apply to return Bundle 0..*. FHIR-46313 further relaxed the Bundle output to allow any combination of request resources, explicitly including CarePlan and RequestOrchestration, and FHIR-51557 clarified plural Bundle response encoding.
reconciliation: No source edit was needed. The build-scoped operation definition currently returns Bundle 0..* and the operation and PlanDefinition narrative both state that result Bundles can contain request resources including CarePlan and RequestOrchestration.
